title.en: Gold v2 account and billing boundary hardening
title.zh: Gold v2 账户与付款边界加固

purpose.en: Synchronize generic account and billing-boundary fixes confirmed during the GreatLove Gold v2 migration while preserving SmartLingo boundaries.
purpose.zh: 同步 GreatLove Gold v2 迁移中确认的通用账户及付款边界修复，同时保留 SmartLingo 边界。

en: Rate-limit administrator member creation, bound its JSON body, and canonicalize submitted email addresses.
Remove source-site naming from the public SmartPay ABI response.
Remove the replaced viewer presence before rotating into a publisher session.
zh: 限制管理员创建会员的频率、限制其 JSON 请求体，并规范化提交的邮箱地址。
从公开 SmartPay ABI 响应中移除来源站点命名。
切换为发布者会话前移除被替换的观众在线记录。

en: Administrator member creation and SmartPay ABI metadata only.
No language course, learning record, referral, certificate, price, entitlement, or stored object changes.
zh: 仅影响管理员创建会员及 SmartPay ABI 元数据。
不更改语言课程、学习记录、推荐、证书、价格、权益或既有存储对象。

en: Apply a 60-per-hour admin-member request budget, an 8 KiB JSON limit, and canonical email validation.
Rename the ABI comparison key to the generic comparison field.
Report Leave for the old viewer session before the publisher join creates a new presence.
Pin browserslist 4.28.8 for the newly disclosed high-severity fixes.
zh: 应用每小时 60 次的管理员会员请求预算、8 KiB JSON 限制及规范邮箱验证。
将 ABI 比较键改为通用 comparison 字段。
发布者加入生成新在线记录前，为旧观众会话报告离开。
锁定 browserslist 4.28.8，修复新披露的高危漏洞。

en: TypeScript and zero-warning ESLint pass locally.

All source contracts pass except six rendered-Worker tests that require the production build artifact unavailable under the signed Codex Node runtime; GitHub Actions must run the complete Linux build and suite.
npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities and git whitespace checks pass.
zh: 本地 TypeScript 与零警告 ESLint 通过。
除六项需要生产构建产物、但受 Codex 签名 Node 运行时限制的渲染 Worker 测试外，源码契约通过；GitHub Actions 必须完成 Linux 全构建及套件。
npm audit 报告零漏洞，Git 空白检查通过。

en: No learning, realtime, payment-rule, provider, or data migration is included.
zh: 本次不包含学习、实时、付款规则、服务商或数据迁移变更。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's twelve-language routes, official course catalog, learning records, AI safety labels, Worker, D1, R2, Clerk, RealtimeKit, and payment resources.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 的十二语言路由、正式课程目录、学习记录、AI 安全标识，以及独立 Worker、D1、R2、Clerk、RealtimeKit 与付款资源。
